objective: Find parts of the app-studio harness (human-language steps that cost tokens each run) that can safely move to deterministic code.
rules: Read-only: no PRs, no issues, no wiki, no edits.
Read ONLY the files of your own slice. Never read other slices or earlier audit reports.
Skip what is already scripted: look in scripts/ before proposing a script.
Mark each finding 'safe' (fixed rules: counting, parsing, copying, checking, formatting) or 'needs-judgement'.
saving_tokens is a rough estimate per run; frequency is how often the step runs: every-session, every-feature, every-release, rare.
synthesis: Rank findings by tokens saved x frequency, then risk (safe first). Group findings that need the same script into one proposed issue. Output one row per proposed issue: what it does, safe/needs-judgement, saving, owner tier?, live check?, coherence review?, needs first. Then the order and a one-line recommendation.

coherence.note: Each check says why it stays. Mechanical drift (names, commands, model names, pointers into CLAUDE.md) is scripts/coherence-lint.mjs, not a check here. Last run and what it taught: docs/COHERENCE-REVIEW.md.

checks.prompt: Find studio-side procedure shipped to apps, apps pointed at the studio's path instead of filing a harness-idea issue, and a role (App-Studio Owner, App Creator, Tester, Admin) used in a scope where it does not exist.
checks.why: Found nothing on 2026-11-27 (two legitimate mentions of the App-Studio Owner). Kept as one cheap check, merged from two, because a leak here misleads every app.

checks.prompt: Find steps in skills, agents, module docs or the app template that contradict docs/GOVERNANCE.md or each other (compare rules of the same scope only).

For each module (packs/*/skills, agents and managed docs): find a rule that contradicts the core's git rules, merge rule, sign-off or who merges, or that works only in one phase (discovery, build) without saying so. Check every exception a module makes says it is one.
checks.why: Added 2026-11-27: the sign-off wait against merge-on-green, and required checks a discovery app does not have, were only visible when a module was read against the template.

checks.prompt: Find every step that says how a result, a test script, a question or an Admin step reaches the App Creator, and list the ones that disagree with the template's "Point, don't repeat" (the thread says it in its own message; the coordinator only points).
checks.why: Added 2026-11-27: four skills still sent results through the coordinator after the template changed. Not mechanical: the wording varies.

checks.prompt: Find a rule stated in two files that a thread reads in the same session (a module's WORKFLOW.md or STACK.md against the app template and project instructions; a skill against GOVERNANCE). Keep the copy nearest the step and report the other, unless the template says the repeat is on purpose.
checks.why: Was copied-rules; widened on 2026-11-27 to module docs, where the copies were.
